name: human_decide
_comment: The arbiter's human pause, reached through the ARCH-02 semantic route. The Developer Verifier raises the SAME footprint objection three times, each under a `### B1` heading, so the findings get the stable IDs DV-1-B1 / DV-2-B1 / DV-3-B1. Streak 2 triggers arch.semantic_repeat, which rules SAME_OBJECTION_REVIEWER_RIGHT and buys ONE compliance revision; streak 3 rules the same case the same way again, so the existing full arbiter (arch.arbiter) runs and returns NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION. Without --human-answer the run PAUSES (AWAITING_HUMAN); with it the decision is fed back as a binding ruling, the Developer then returns FEASIBLE and the Tech Lead READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW -> PASS at iteration 4. Exactly two semantic calls and one full-arbiter call. (2026-08-31: this fixture no longer claims to test escalate_after_cycles=5 — that precedence is pinned by tests/test_semantic_repeat.py, which asserts the threshold still outranks the audit.)
